name: Rajarshi Shahu Maharaj Scholarship (EBC)
des: The Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC) — commonly known as the EBC Scholarship — is a Maharashtra Government scholarship scheme implemented by multiple technical departments (DTE, DHE, Agriculture, etc.) through the MahaDBT portal. It provides 50% tuition fee and 50% examination fee reimbursement to students belonging to the Open (General) category who fall under Economically Backward Class (EBC) or Economically Weaker Section (EWS). The scheme is governed by Government Resolutions (GRs) dated 7 Oct 2017, 1 Mar 2018, 31 Mar 2018, 11 Jul 2019, and 8 Jul 2024. Benefits are disbursed in 2 installments directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Importantly, only Open (General/EWS) category students are eligible — OBC, SC, ST, NT, and SEBC category students are NOT eligible for this scheme as they have separate dedicated scholarship schemes.
benefits: 50% reimbursement of Tuition Fees for the academic year
Applicable for Diploma, Degree (UG), and Postgraduate (PG) technical and professional courses
Benefits disbursed in 2 installments via DBT to Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Applicable across multiple departments — DTE (Engineering/Pharmacy), DHE (Arts/Science/Commerce), Agriculture, etc.
Special provision: For OBC Girl students in professional courses — 100% Tuition Fee + Exam Fee reimbursement available under a separate variant (GR dated 8 July 2024)
Application for A.Y. 2025–26 commenced from 30 June 2025 and valid until 30 June 2026
criteria: Applicant must be an Indian citizen and permanent resident/domicile of Maharashtra
Applicant must belong to Open (General) category — EBC or EWS only
OBC, SC, ST, NT, SEBC, VJNT category students are NOT eligible (they have separate schemes)
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000
Must be a bonafide student enrolled in a Diploma, Degree, or Postgraduate Technical/Professional course in a government-recognized institution
Admission must be through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) — management quota or institute-level admissions are NOT eligible
Deemed Universities and Private Universities are NOT eligible
Student must not be receiving any other major government scholarship or stipend simultaneously
For renewal: student must have passed and been promoted to the next year; failure in any year = scholarship forfeiture until promotion
Course must be listed in the applicable GR for the relevant department (DTE/DHE/Agriculture/etc.)
required_documents: Annual Income Certificate from Tehsildar/SDO (family income ≤ ₹8 lakh)
CAP Allotment Letter (mandatory — proof of CAP round admission)
College Admission Receipt / Fee Receipt for current academic year
EWS Certificate (if applicable — for EWS category students)
Caste Certificate confirming Open/General category (no reservation caste certificate)
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register with Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal, academic, and bank details
Navigate to your relevant department — DTE (for Engineering/Pharmacy/Diploma), DHE (for Arts/Science/Commerce), or other applicable department
Select 'Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana (EBC)' and click Apply
Fill in course details, institution details, CAP allotment details, and bank account information accurately
Upload all required documents in JPG/PDF format as specified
Review all details carefully and submit the application
Note the Application ID and track real-time status using Granular Application Tracking on MahaDBT portal
Applications for A.Y. 2025–26 are open from 30 June 2025 until 30 June 2026; re-apply for A.Y. 2023–24 and 2024–25 also valid until 30 June 2026
